# Let Meta AI draft your Outlook replies in seconds

**Hook:**
Imagine cutting your daily inbox time in half. Meta AI can read an email, suggest a polite reply, and let you send it with one click—all inside Outlook. No extra apps, no copy-pasting. This guide shows you how to set it up in under 10 minutes.

## Before you start
- A **Microsoft Outlook desktop or web account** (free or paid).
- A **device with internet** (computer, tablet or phone).
- Roughly **10 minutes** of your time.
- No coding or AI experience needed.

---

## Step 1 — Open Outlook and find the Meta AI button
Open Outlook on your computer or go to [outlook.live.com](https://outlook.live.com) in a browser. Look for a small **Meta AI icon** (a blue circle with a white “M”) near the top-right corner of the screen. It usually sits next to the search bar or inside the compose window. If you don’t see it, look for a button like “**Meta AI**” or “**Ask Meta AI**” in the ribbon menu.
You'll know it worked when you see the Meta AI icon or the “Ask Meta AI” button on your screen.

💬 Example: You open Outlook and see the Meta AI icon in the top-right corner.

---

## Step 2 — Start a new email or open an incoming one
Click **New Message** to draft a reply, or open an email you want to answer. A new email window opens. At the bottom of that window, you’ll see a small text box labelled **“Ask Meta AI”** or a blue **Meta AI icon**. Click inside the box to activate Meta AI.
You'll know it worked when the cursor moves into the “Ask Meta AI” box and a small loading spinner appears briefly.

💬 Example: You click inside the “Ask Meta AI” box at the bottom of the email window.

---

## Step 3 — Type a short prompt asking for a reply
In the “Ask Meta AI” box, type a simple instruction like:
💬 Example:
> Draft a polite reply thanking the sender and asking for more details.

Meta AI will read the original email and generate a suggested reply in the same window. You’ll see the reply appear just above the box, usually in grey text.
You'll know it worked when a suggested reply appears above the “Ask Meta AI” box.

---

## Step 4 — Review and edit the draft
Read the suggested reply carefully. Meta AI usually gets the tone right, but you may want to tweak it. Click inside the suggested reply box to edit it, or highlight any part and type over it. If the reply is too long or too short, Meta AI will usually adjust when you ask again.
You'll know it worked when you can freely edit the suggested reply in the same window.

💬 Example: You change “Looking forward to your response” to “Let me know your thoughts by Friday.”

---

## Step 5 — Send the reply with one click
When you’re happy with the draft, click the **Send** button at the bottom of the email window. Outlook will send the email exactly as you edited it. Meta AI doesn’t send the email for you—it only drafts it.
You'll know it worked when the email disappears from your Outbox and appears in your Sent Items.

---

## Step 6 — Ask Meta AI to shorten or lengthen the reply
If the reply is too long, type a new prompt in the “Ask Meta AI” box:
💬 Example:
> Make this reply shorter, under 50 words.

Meta AI will instantly generate a concise version. If you need a more detailed reply, type:
💬 Example:
> Expand this reply to include a meeting request next week.

You'll know it worked when Meta AI generates a new version matching your length request.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Mistake:** You can’t find the Meta AI button.
  **Fix:** Look for a button like “Ask Meta AI” in the ribbon menu. If it’s missing, check if you’re using the latest version of Outlook or try refreshing the page.

- **Mistake:** The suggested reply doesn’t match the email.
  **Fix:** Rephrase your prompt to include more details, like “Draft a reply thanking the sender for the invitation and asking about the agenda.”

- **Mistake:** You accidentally send the email before editing.
  **Fix:** Always review the suggested reply before clicking Send. You can edit it freely.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** Quickly reply to routine emails like meeting invites, follow-ups, or customer questions without typing every word yourself. Save 5–10 minutes per day.

- **For your business or work:** Handle high-volume inboxes efficiently. Meta AI helps maintain a professional tone across dozens of daily replies, freeing you to focus on strategy instead of typing.

- **If you're just getting started:** Start with one short prompt like “Draft a polite reply” and build from there. Once you see how fast it works, you’ll trust it for more emails.

---

## Try it now
Open Outlook, open an email you need to reply to, and type in the “Ask Meta AI” box:
💬 Example:
> Draft a short reply accepting an invitation and asking for the agenda.

Send the reply after you review it. That’s your first automated reply—done in under two minutes.
